# Gold Standard Guidelines

> Canonical engineering, design, data, AI and operational standards — 117 source-grounded, machine-readable, CI-validated documents.
> 117 documents, 8 domains. Normative language: MUST / MUST NOT / SHOULD / SHOULD NOT.
> Status: 117 provisional (draft) standards awaiting review. Generated 2026-09-23.

Start with foundation/ (principles, naming & terminology, authoring, glossary) before applying any standard.

## Foundation (1)
- [Foundation Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/foundation/00-index.md): This is the entry point to the cross-cutting layer of our standards. standards/ tells you what to do in each domain (design, engineering, data, AI, security, operations, process); foundation/ tells you why, what the words mean, and how t…

## Design & UX (36)

- [Aesthetic & Visual Language](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/08-aesthetic.md): This standard defines the visual identity layer of the product system: how the product should look, feel, behave, and express the brand before those decisions are encoded into Design Tokens, Layout rules, Components, or Patterns.
- [Empty Loading Error States Catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/09-states-catalogue.md): This standard defines the canonical UX, component, state-management, accessibility, layout, recovery, and content-writing requirements for:

- [Tables & Data Grid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/11-tables.md): This standard defines how structured datasets MUST be presented, navigated, queried, selected, edited, exported, and made accessible.
- [Motion & Interaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/12-motion.md): This standard defines the canonical requirements for motion, transition, animation, and gesture behaviour across product interfaces.
- [Iconography & Illustration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/13-iconography.md): This standard defines how visual symbols and supporting imagery MUST be selected, created, licensed, implemented, optimised, and used across the product system.

- [Overlays & Layering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/15-overlays.md): This standard defines the canonical requirements for transient and layered application surfaces.

- [Design Review & Handoff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/17-design-review.md): Design review and engineering handoff exist to ensure that approved product design can be implemented without ambiguity, silent interpretation, avoidable rework, or divergence from the design system.
- [Colour, Typography & Type Systems](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/18-colour-type-systems.md): This standard defines the canonical production rules for colour architecture, contrast, data-visualisation palettes, typography, type behaviour in components, implementation tokens, and rendering modes.
- [Spacing, Grid, Density, Elevation & Hierarchy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/19-spacing-grid-depth.md): This specification defines the canonical spatial and visual-composition system for the product.
- [Design Style Catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/20-style-catalogue.md): This catalogue defines reproducible visual recipes for 28 distinct interface design styles. Its purpose is not to prescribe one aesthetic, but to make aesthetic direction implementable through tokens without compromising accessibility, c…
- [Corporate & Enterprise Visual Standards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/21-corporate-enterprise-visual.md): Corporate and Enterprise Visual Standards define how an organisation presents information when credibility, continuity, traceability, accessibility, legal clarity, and institutional identity matter more than visual novelty.
- [Brand & White-label Application](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/22-brand-whitelabel.md): This standard defines how a production application incorporates first-party, tenant, client and partner brands without weakening usability, accessibility, security, component consistency, data integrity, attribution requirements or opera…
- [Anti-AI-Slop & Craft Standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/23-anti-ai-slop.md): The Anti-AI-Slop & Craft Standard defines how teams MUST identify, reject, and replace interface design that is superficially polished but contextually generic.
- [Image Prompt Engineering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/24-image-prompt-engineering.md): This standard defines how text-to-image and image-editing models are used to produce repeatable, on-brand, production-ready visual assets rather than one-off generated images.
- [Visual Style Recipe Library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/25-visual-style-recipes.md): The Visual Style Recipe Library defines reusable text-to-image directions for product, editorial, marketing, data, scientific, geospatial, and institutional visual production.
- [Ready-to-Use Visual Prompt Packs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/26-prompt-packs.md): This catalogue provides copy-paste production prompt packs for the visual assets product teams repeatedly need:
- [Component Design & Variant Contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/27-component-variant-contract.md): The Component Design & Variant Contract defines the minimum public, visual, semantic, interaction, accessibility, and testing guarantees required for every reusable component.
- [Forms, Data Entry & Editors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/28-forms-editors.md): Forms are transactional interfaces. Their purpose is to let users create or modify valid product state with the least possible ambiguity, unnecessary work, and risk of data loss.
- [Search, Navigation & Wayfinding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/29-search-navigation.md): Search, Navigation & Wayfinding define how users answer three different questions:
- [Overlays, Feedback & Micro-interactions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/30-overlays-feedback.md): Overlays and feedback mechanisms control attention.
- [Dashboard, Data Viz & Map Interaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/31-dashboard-dataviz-map.md): This standard defines how data is composed, encoded, prioritised, explored, and interpreted in user interfaces.
- [Accessibility & Inclusive Design Patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/32-a11y-inclusive.md): Accessibility is a product-quality requirement, not an engineering remediation phase.
- [Content, Microcopy, Help & Onboarding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/33-content-microcopy.md): Content is part of the interface.
- [Design System Governance, Tokens & Docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/34-ds-governance-tokens.md): This standard defines how a production design system is governed, tokenized, built, themed, documented, versioned, adopted, measured, deprecated, and evolved across web, iOS, Android, and design tools.
- [Design QA, Critique, Visual Regression & UX Metrics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/35-design-qa-metrics.md): Design quality MUST be verifiable.
- [Handoff, Prototyping & Figma Library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/design/36-handoff-figma.md): This standard defines the contract between design artifacts, prototypes, the Figma design system, and production code.

- [Mobile & Native App](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/engineering/32-mobile-native.md): Mobile applications operate under constraints that do not exist, or do not exist to the same degree, in browser-based applications.

- [Geospatial & Map Guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/data/06-geospatial.md): This standard defines the canonical requirements for geospatial data storage, transformation, querying, delivery, visualization, offline use, and export.

- [Scientific & Environmental Data Quality](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/data/12-env-data-quality.md): Scientific and environmental data are meaningful only when their measurement basis, uncertainty, provenance, quality state, temporal semantics, and transformations remain explicit.

## AI & LLM (7)
- [AI/LLM Guidelines — Gold Standard 2026](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/ai/01-ai-llm.md): These guidelines define the canonical organizational standard for applications using:
- [Prompt Engineering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/ai/02-prompt-engineering.md): Prompt engineering is production software engineering.
- [AI Agent Guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/ai/03-ai-agents.md): An AI agent is a model-driven runtime that can perform multi-step work by inspecting state, selecting actions, invoking tools, observing results, delegating work, and continuing until a defined stopping condition is reached.
- [RAG & Vector Retrieval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/ai/04-rag.md): This standard defines the canonical architecture, data contracts, retrieval behavior, security controls, ranking strategy, user experience, evaluation framework, and operational requirements for Retrieval-Augmented Generation and vector…
- [AI Evaluation & Red-team](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/ai/05-ai-eval.md): AI evaluation is the disciplined process of measuring whether an AI system behaves correctly, safely, reliably, fairly, and efficiently under representative and adversarial conditions.
- [Prompt Library & Governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/ai/06-prompt-library.md): This standard defines the canonical engineering, security, ownership, lifecycle, deployment, testing, audit, and user-interface requirements for production prompts.
- [AI UX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/ai/07-ai-ux.md): This standard defines the canonical UX requirements for interfaces powered by generative AI, language models, multimodal models, agents, retrieval systems, and AI-assisted workflows.

## Security, Privacy & Compliance (8)
- [Security Guidelines — Gold Standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/01-security.md): These guidelines define the minimum security standard for product engineering.
- [Authentication & Authorization Guidelines — Gold Standard 2026](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/02-authentication-authorization.md): These guidelines define the canonical standard for:
- [Privacy & Data Governance Guidelines — Gold Standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/03-privacy-data-governance.md): These guidelines define the canonical organizational standard for:
- [Secrets & Key Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/04-secrets.md): This standard defines the canonical requirements for creating, storing, distributing, using, rotating, revoking, recovering, auditing, and destroying secrets and cryptographic keys.
- [Rate Limiting & Abuse Defense](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/05-abuse.md): This standard defines how the platform MUST protect shared services and business workflows from excessive, automated, fraudulent, or abusive use while preserving availability and fair access for legitimate users.
- [Threat Modeling & Secure SDLC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/06-threat-model.md): Threat modeling and the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) define how security risk is identified, designed against, verified, accepted, and monitored throughout the lifecycle of a system or feature.
- [Audit Logging & Compliance Evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/07-audit-logging.md): This standard defines the canonical requirements for security audit logging and compliance evidence.
- [Legal & Licensing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/standards/security/08-legal-licensing.md): This standard defines the minimum legal and licensing controls for software and digital assets used, modified, distributed, deployed, or contributed by the organisation.

## Machine-readable
- [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/index.json): full catalogue — id, domain, status, tags, applies_to, related, path
- [front matter schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/schema/frontmatter.schema.json): metadata contract every document must satisfy
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/gold-standard-guidelines/main/llms-full.txt): complete text of every standard in one file
